claim: The finite diagonal successor embedding induces the same Cantor-boundary L2 element: representing diagEmbedSucc n f at stage n+1 equals representing f at stage n.

carrier.type: DiagAlg n := (Fin n → Bool) → ℂ; L2Boundary := Lp ℂ 2 fractalMeasure
operations: diagEmbedSucc n extends a finite observable by ignoring the last bit.
diagonalCylinderL2 n sends f to the L2 class of cylinder n f.
cylinder_compatible_succ n f identifies the two underlying boundary functions.
conventions: Equality is equality in the quotient Lp carrier, not merely equality of selected representatives.
This is successor-stage compatibility only; it does not assert a colimit completion or density result.

consumers: This is the compatibility equation needed for the finite-stage L2 maps to descend along the existing diagonal successor system.

smallest_gap.pantograph_expression: ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ f : DiagAlg n, diagonalCylinderL2 (n + 1) (diagEmbedSucc n f) = diagonalCylinderL2 n f
smallest_gap.description: Transport the already-proved equality of successor-compatible cylinder functions through MemLp.toLp to equality in the concrete boundary L2 space.

out_of_scope: No full filtered-colimit or Hilbert completion identification.
No density theorem for finite cylinder functions in the whole boundary L2 space.
No identification with the full finite-matrix GNS colimit or a concrete Cuntz KMS theorem.
